ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-04-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maria Torreano.
Kenyette C. Jones, Esq. for Petitioner: James Michael Anthony Soto, also present, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: James Michael Anthony De Soto.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-19-2004 Reset To Nov-04-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
